title: Mitigating Bias with Words: Inducing Demographic Ambiguity in Face Recognition Templates by Text Encoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in face verification accuracy by calculating the Standard Deviation (STD) and Skewed Error Ratio (SER) across four racial demographic groups (African, Asian, Caucasian, Indian) using the RFW and BFW datasets.
Evaluating disparities in face verification accuracy by calculating the Standard Deviation (STD) and Skewed Error Ratio (SER) across female and male groups using the BFW dataset.
